approach: Reuse unchanged previously read/rechecked claims. Target actual M01/M05/M06/M07/M08/M09/M10 residuals and precise binding corrections; do not repeat the earlier whole-source review or claim clinical sign-off.
access_limits: WHO/NCBI direct guideline returned captcha; NICE direct recommendations 403; BVS WHO mirror yielded title/ISBN/contents then later timeout. New WHO assertions are bound only to actual indexed original recommendation text, not to claimed full-PDF reading.
Unused searches/read material are not added as evidence. LPT old review deadline and several overbroad unrelated statements were identified; those statements were not adopted.

scope_and_remaining_boundaries: Cause-based meningitis overview, not a full pathogen-specific or neonatal treatment manual. Exact drug doses, TB duration, antifungal immune thresholds and local vaccine schedules are not claimed complete.

Treatment-3 immune-risk admission detail is directly CDC-supported; MSD confirms normal-immunity recovery and severe-illness treatment, not a duplicate exact admission rule. The author does not assert two sources for that complete compound paragraph. Independent reviewer should assess this bounded explanatory detail separately from emergency actions.
NICE is the direct source for dedicated TB-specialist referral; MSD independently confirms multidrug and distinct meningeal treatment, not the exact referral wording.
WHO/NICE hearing timing and steroid eligibility are attributed recommendations with real differences, not two identical global rules or independent trials.

coding_recommendation.candidate_scope: Generic/unspecified meningitis leaf categories may be assessed against this overview; named bacterial/viral/fungal/TB/neonatal leaves are not automatically confirmed. Root holds frozen WHO definitions and will adjudicate exact codes.

source_reads.scope: Read P8: Listeria can multiply at ordinary refrigerator temperatures over sufficient time. Supports refrigeration not eliminating Listeria, not a new household storage-day instruction.

PDF pp1–2,9,12–14 actually read. Section 3.2 p9: contacts may acquire the virus but are unlikely to develop viral meningitis. Ratified 5 Dec 2023; review date 1 May 2026 has passed; expiry 1 Nov 2026. Only the contact statement is used, corroborated by current CDC; the policy’s overbroad Gram-stain guarantee and reassurance on sequelae are not used.

Read When to see a doctor: seek help right away if baby refuses nursing or fluids. Infant illness safety-net material, not evidence that meningitis is a cold; used with NHS vomiting/feeding advice. Exact edition day not established.
Full review/update September 2026. Read Diagnosis: lumbar puncture; Treatment: antibiotics, including age/immune status, culture/sensitivity adjustment and resistance. No day invented.
Full review/update February 2026. Read overview and Treatment of Extrapulmonary TB: combination therapy and longer meningeal treatment than most other sites. No day or universal regimen invented.

Full review/update September 2026. Read Symptoms, Diagnosis, Treatment and Prognosis: immediate treatment if very ill, antiviral exceptions, recovery in people with normal immunity. No claim it independently gives CDC’s full immune-risk hospitalization rule.
Read definition, symptoms and emergency advice: sudden severe headache can represent intracranial bleeding. Used as a differential example; no home diagnostic rule or exact threshold added.

Updated 29 Oct 2024; reviewed 16 Mar 2026. Read Clinical manifestations and Treating CNS/disseminated disease, maintenance stopping/restarting criteria. Adults/adolescents with HIV and cryptococcosis only; immune recovery example, not a regimen for every fungus.

Read What is meningococcal disease? (meningitis and/or sepsis), Symptoms including nonfeeding child and prompt review, and Public health response. Australian context retained; vaccine ages not imported.

Read Investigations: urgent LP, blood, neuroimaging; Treatment, antibiotic table and ongoing management. Children only; no fluid doses or routine restriction copied into the lay overview. Relevant paragraphs actually opened.

Read Management of contacts / Providing antibiotic chemoprophylaxis: identified close contacts of confirmed/probable cases need prophylaxis regardless of vaccination. Used only to corroborate contact assessment after vaccination; outbreak-specific population and timing are not globalized.

Previously read/rechecked WHO 2025 scope and C.4 hearing recommendations retained. This round actually read indexed WHO-authored A.1 hemodynamic/respiratory compromise; A.3 peripheral blood tests cannot exclude; A.4 selective imaging; B.1 oxygen/hemodynamic support; B.2 allergy/resistance; B.5 fluid management. Direct NCBI CAPTCHA, WHO PDF error and BVS mirror timeout do not count as full guideline reading. BVS PDF title/ISBN/contents only were opened.
